{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99

# Drop QA orders
df_clean = df[~qa_mask]

# Confirm we have 894 rows
assert len(df_clean) == 894, f'Expected 894, got {len(df_clean)}'

# Now compute conversion rate by customer_segment
# Conversion rate = (sum of converted) / (total count) for each segment
conversion_by_segment = df_clean.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
conversion_by_segment['rate'] = conversion_by_segment['sum'] / conversion_by_segment['count']

# Sort by rate descending
conversion_by_segment = conversion_by_segment.sort_values('rate', ascending=False)

# Display results
conversion_by_segment"}
